sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
With 9 attack and 8 defense, this card can knock out almost all hero's on a 1 on 1 combat without being defeat itself. However, you must at the start of each round eliminate a friendly hero. A good tactic is using [[SAS-050|Ymir: Frost Giant]] and his [[TCG:SAS-083|Ice Creatures]], so you can eliminate the Ice Creatures, then call them back each round. [[SAS-028|Breaker:Grier's Titan]] is also very handy; if the Shauna and Wind card is in trouble, the combat action may be used.

Use of the [[SAS-031|Fireblade: Friend in the Shadows]] and [[TCG:SAS-082|Gawain: Forest Warrior]] combo is very effective, too. This strategy works amazing with [[LGS-017|Ashtoreth: Colossus]], [[SAS-046|Rassimov: Dangerous Mind]], and [[LGS-051|Suit: Mr. Koskin, Elite Agent]]. You can very often get a minor hero back, setting it up to be a tribute the next turn.
